plan.title: Agent MCP and bots (W-CI1): CI for the integration packages
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: The four outside-bot integration packages under integrations/ (PAN-4927 Part B) are on main, but CI never runs the Hermes plugin's pytest suite or builds and tests the OpenClaw plugin from its own lockfile (its tests sit outside the root Vitest include globs), and the shared skill check runs only indirectly. A broken package can merge unnoticed. PAN-4927 FR-15 and AC-29 require an `integrations` CI job that runs the skill check, the Hermes tests and the OpenClaw build and tests, and is green.
narratives.Proposal: Add one self-contained GitHub Actions job `integrations` to .github/workflows/ci.yml after mobile-android: checkout, Node 22, `node integrations/shared/sync-skill.mjs --check`, Python 3.11 with `pip install -e 'integrations/hermes[test]'` and `python -m pytest integrations/hermes`, then `npm ci`, `npm run build`, `npm test` in integrations/openclaw. Add it to the `test` aggregator's needs so a red package blocks Overdeck's merge gate and reaches the work agent as CI verification feedback (mobile-android precedent). Document the job in integrations/README.md and the codebase map. All commands were verified locally on 2026-11-04: skill check OK, Hermes 81 passed, OpenClaw 94 passed.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No change to package code, tests or manifests under integrations/ other than integrations/README.md
- No CI step for grok-build/ or grok-bot/: their tests already run in the root test shards via tests/unit/integrations/
- No pip or npm dependency caching
- No paths filter or job-level if on the integrations job
- No bun install, root build, Playwright or ripgrep install in the integrations job
- No new Vitest file that parses ci.yml
- No branch protection changes
- No publishing of any package to PyPI, npm or a plugin catalog
- No Mintlify page changes (W-DOC, PAN-4958)

autoDecisions.summary: Add `integrations` to the `test` aggregator's needs (the parent PRD only says 'next to mobile-android').
autoDecisions.rationale: Overdeck's merge gate and CI verification feedback read only the `test` check (TEST_GATE_NAME, isCiTestCheckName does not match `integrations`), so without the aggregator a red package would be advisory; mobile-android (PAN-4837 D-10) set this precedent.

autoDecisions.summary: Keep the job id exactly `integrations` rather than a test-prefixed name.
autoDecisions.rationale: AC-29 names the job `integrations`; the aggregator wiring makes it count for the test gate without renaming.

autoDecisions.summary: Run the job on every PR with no paths filter.
autoDecisions.rationale: The parent PRD says 'on every PR', and a skipped needs job would make the aggregator's `= success` assertion fail and block unrelated PRs.

autoDecisions.summary: No pip or npm caching; one step per command with working-directory for OpenClaw.
autoDecisions.rationale: Installs take seconds (47 npm packages, pytest and hatchling); per-command steps make the failing command the failing step name, matching the mobile-android Gradle step style.

autoDecisions.summary: Docs scope is integrations/README.md and the codebase map row only.
autoDecisions.rationale: Mintlify pages belong to W-DOC (PAN-4958) and do not describe CI jobs; the README already describes the skill check and its CI coverage, which this change alters.

expected_outputs: on the PR, gh pr checks lists integrations and test as pass

narrative.Action: Follow PRD .pan/drafts/pan-4957.md WI-4 before/after snippet. In the `test` job of .github/workflows/ci.yml: change needs to [test-shard, test-e2e, mobile-android, integrations]; add the echo line `echo "integrations:   ${{ needs.integrations.result }}"` after the mobile-android echo; add `test "${{ needs.integrations.result }}" = success` after the mobile-android assert; reword the comment above `test:` to say green only when every shard, test-e2e, mobile-android and integrations passed. Keep if: always() and timeout-minutes: 5. This makes a red package block Overdeck's merge gate and reach the work agent as CI verification feedback, because both read the `test` check (PRD D-2). After the PR exists, confirm with gh pr checks on the whole job set. Order for AC-29 (ac3 needs a PR before pan done): SSH-push the branch, open the PR with `gh pr create --base main --head feature/pan-4957`, wait once with `gh pr checks <pr> --watch`, then mark ci-test-aggregator.ac3 done, then run pan done (it adopts the open PR, src/dashboard/server/routes/workspaces/ensure-pr.ts:69-72).
